chapter: Union, publishers, race and Harlem nightlife
title: Theatre stage bands and pit orchestras
summary: He played Loew's State, the Strand and Paramount on stage; black players rarely sat in the pit.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What about the theatres and things downtown? Were any black musicians playing then?
I played so many.
In the shows downtown?
Yeah, shows.
In the theatres.
They had the chorus girls then.
And pit bands and things like that?
White and colored.
Did they have mixed bands?
Yeah.
They played at Loew's State.
When was that?
He played Loew's State in New York. He played the Strand in New York when Josephine Baker used to come over.
Played the Paramount Theatre. Played all the big theatres in New York, all the theatres.
Pit orchestras?
No, they were on the stage.
But what about the orchestra that sat below, the regular musicians that stayed there. Like Broadway musicals.
(SEVERAL VOICES AT ONCE)
Were any black people playing in the pit orchestras? In a musical show downtown where they had an orchestra playing, black would they hire any jazz musicians?
Very seldom. I haven't seen a Negro yet in the pit and they keep a band now all the time and then they have a band on the stage. We played on the stage.
You remember the guy that said, 'Charlie, open the door?' He played at the Strand Theatre.
'Open the Door, Richard.'

He didn't get famous until he was almost ready to die. He played at the Strand Theatre, that I know. When Jay and them was playing at the theatre or even in the pit, Josephine Baker would come over to New York. She was the entertainer and there would be quite a few entertainers, white and colored.
Why would they use Josephine Baker?
They didn't just use Josephine Baker. They had Buddy Rich.
We played together out in Chicago. and she was doing the same act
They sat in the pit. Then they got so they sat on the stage, back of the performers.
You're talking about the orchestra used to be in the pit and then it moved up on the stage? But did they have black musicians in the pit?
They had black musicians at the Strand Theatre.
In the pit?
They had black musicians at the Capital Theatre. They had black musicians at the Loew's State Theatre, 'cause I was there.
